title: this might be the recipe of the summer 🤤
description:
save this for your next bbq! recipe below⬇️

📹: @theveganpigeon

Grilled Onion Beyond Smash Burgers

SERVINGS: 4 burgers
PREP TIME: 5 minutes
COOK TIME: 10 minutes

INGREDIENTS:
2 packages Beyond Burgers
4 burger buns
4 slices of plant-based cheese
2 onions, sliced
1 tomato, sliced
Shredded romaine lettuce
Dill pickle chips

Burger Sauce:
⅓ cup plant-based mayo
1 tbsp mustard
1 tbsp ketchup
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp onion powder
½ tsp smoked paprika
1 tsp apple cider vinegar
2 tbsp chopped dill pickles

PREPARATION:
1. Preheat the flat top griddle to medium-high heat. Lightly coat with oil. Add onion slices and let onions grill for 2-3 minutes.
2. Add Beyond Burgers on top of sauteed onion slices. Use a burger press and ‘smash’ each patty into the onion slices.
3. Prepare plant-based burger sauce by mixing all ingredients together. Set aside.
4. Cook each burger for about four minutes before gently flipping, making sure to keep onions with the burger. Cook for about 4 minutes on the other side and gently flip again.
5. Add a slice of plant-based cheese, adding a bit of water (no more than 1 tsp) around the burger and covering to let steam until cheese is melted. If desired, toast each bun on the griddle for a few minutes. Lower heat on the griddle to keep all ingredients warm.
6. Assemble the smash burger, starting with coating the toasted buns with the burger sauce. Add 3-4 dill pickle chips to the bottom bun, along with sliced tomato and shredded lettuce. Top with the Beyond onion smash burger and cover with the top bun.

title: The Impossible Hot Dog Takeover at Slutty Vegan
description:
We brought our Impossible Hot Dogs to Slutty Vegan for a day, and this time, we got a little…corny. Keep an eye out for our Impossible Hot Dog on restaurant menus this year.

More on the Impossible Hot Dog:
Kind of obsessed with meat? We’re right there with you. That’s why we took so much time and care to make you this beefy, meaty treat that tastes like a delicious hot dog, because it is a delicious hot dog…made from plants! Only this one’s got 12g of protein and half the saturated fat of the animal version.* Plus it generates 84% less greenhouse gas emissions, uses 77% less water and 83% less land than an animal beef hot dog.** But don’t worry, it still tastes like an awesomely bad decision.

*Saturated fat per serving: A leading animal  beef hot dog 6g, Impossible Hot Dog 3g.
**Impossible Beef Hot Dogs US LCA (2023).

title: Taste the real Mediterranean flavours with this Fusilli pasta Recipe!
description:
Transport your taste buds to the shores of the Mediterranean with this pasta dish full of vibrant flavours! 😎

Ingredients (serves 4):
320g Barilla Fusilli
4 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 medium onion, sliced
2 garlic cloves, roughly chopped
¼ tsp dried chilli flakes
100ml white wine
1 pinch saffron (optional)
4 tbsp tomato puree
400g chopped tomatoes, canned
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
400g hake or cod, skinned and cubed (2 cm)
1 lemon, zest grated
1 tbsp fennel top, roughly chopped

Method:
1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the fusilli according to package instructions. 
2. Drain and reserve 150ml of the cooking water.
3. Meanwhile, heat a skillet until hot, add the extra virgin olive oil, onion and garlic and sauté for 5 minutes until soft.
4. Add the chilli flakes and stir to combine.
5. Stir in the tomato purée, then add the white wine, bring to the boil and cook until reduced by half.
6. Add the chopped tomatoes, salt and black pepper and cook for 5 minutes.
7. Stir in the hake cubes, cover with a lid and simmer for 3-4 minutes until the fish is cooked through.
8. Add the fusilli and toss until coated, adjusting little by little with the cooking water and cooking for 1 minute to get a creamy sauce.
9. Serve topped with the grated lemon zest and fennel tops.

title: 130 m² of chocolate heaven: The opening of the Lindt boutique at Zurich airport
description:
https://www.lindt-spruengli.com

https://www.chocolate.lindt.com/travel-retail/

LINDT brand ambassador Roger Federer and Maître Chocolatier Stefan Bruderer ceremoniously opened the newly designed LINDT Chocolate Boutique at Zurich Airport. At Level 2 in the Airside Center at Zurich Airport, passengers at Zurich Airport can expect a world full of exclusive crea-tions, only available in the creations available there, which leave nothing to be desired by real chocolate lovers. 

Following the official opening, the world-famous tennis star visibly enjoyed the unique chocolate tour by Lindt Maître chocolatier Stefan Bruderer, who personally guided the star guest through the Chocolate Boutique and presented him with all the highlights that chocolate fans from all over the world can expect on 130 m² of sales space. 

A special highlight of the boutique is the new Maître Chocolatier counter, where LINDT Maîtres Chocolatiers demonstrate their craftsmanship with great attention to detail and passengers can experience chocolate up close. In the Chocolate Boutique, the large selection of exquisite master-pieces, chocolate figures, chocolate lollipops, fresh bars and the very exclusive LINDT Piemonte are freshly prepared every day. 

For true LINDOR fans, the true chocolate paradise is located at the impressive colourful Pick & Mix world where they can put together their own personal mix from around 18 different LINDOR balls. Roger Federer immediately took the opportunity and, with the expert advice of Maître Chocolatier Stefan Bruderer, also enjoyed previously unknown lindor creations. He was visibly pleased to be present at the grand opening ceremony and confessed: "The new Chocolate Boutique is my perfect Lindt Stopover at Zurich Airport and makes my departure from Switzerland easier". 

At the renowned gift specialist Lindt & Sprüngli, personalization is a top priority. For this purpose, the gift station in the boutique offers numerous opportunities to turn gifts for loved ones into an individual eye-catcher with personalized ribbons, stickers and fine packaging. In addition, the new Magical Selfie Mirror enriches the interactive shopping experience. Passengers can make a Selfie in the boutique, design it with different frames, send it digitally or print it out on site and perfectly complement the gift. 

To sweeten the farewell from Switzerland for the passengers, the exclusive Travel Retail range was supplemented with a selection of products dedicated to the Swiss home of Lindt & Sprüngli. Start-ing with a Zurich edition of the new LINDT Swiss Masterpieces gift box, through a Swiss Tourist Board, to a Swiss edition of the LINDT Napolitain World Traveller Collection cans. 

https://www.lindt-spruengli.com

https://www.chocolate.lindt.com/travel-retail/

title: Why LINDT chocolate is special
description:
Chocolate, back then
The year was 1879. Rodolphe Lindt, the son of a Bernese pharmacist, wanted to produce chocolate. Now you should know that chocolate at the time was hard: hard to process and hard to eat.  You really had to chew it. It wasn't really sweet either; it was still pretty bitter. It was hardly what you would now call a pleasurable experience.

The adventure begins
Rodolphe Lindt was a confectioner and an epicurean1 and made it his goal to create a chocolate that was mild and would melt in the mouth. Something you could enjoy. How he would get there he did not yet know back then. He bought an old factory hall with antiquated machines and began to experiment with the help of his brother, Auguste, a pharmacist like their father. 

A long journey
First the white coating on the chocolate had to be removed - crystallised fat which, although it was harmless, was not particularly appealing. When that was done, they went about refining the chocolate. More cocoa beans? Cocoa butter even? Nobody had tried so many variations up until then! He worked on the recipe, ran some ideas through his head, tinkered around, but no matter what he did, he did not get any closer to his goal.

title: SNICKERS Peanut Butter Reindeer Blondies
description:
Prepared in a round pan, these Snickers blondies are cut into wedges, then simply decorated for an impressive fun holiday reindeer treat.  

 

Prep Time: 15 minutes 

Cook Time: 20 minutes  

Total Time: 35 minutes  

Makes: 16 servings 

 

Ingredients:  

 

3/4 cup all-purpose flour 

1 tsp baking powder 

1/4 tsp salt 

1/3 cup butter 

1/4 cup peanut butter 

1 cup brown sugar 

1 egg 

2 tsp vanilla extract 

10 SNICKERS® Minis, chopped 

3 tbsp chopped peanuts 

1 tube brown or black gel icing 

16 mini chocolate-covered pretzels, cut in half  

32 small candy eyes 

2 tbsp Christmas sprinkles 

 

Instructions:  

 

Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease 8-inch round baking pan. Line bottom with parchment paper; set aside. Whisk together flour, baking powder and salt; set aside.  

Melt butter and peanut butter in saucepan set over medium heat. While still hot, stir in brown sugar; remove from heat. Transfer to large bowl; let cool slightly. 

Beat in egg and vanilla until incorporated. Stir in flour mixture until just combined. Fold in chopped Snickers and peanuts. Scrape batter into prepared pan, smoothing top.  

Bake on middle rack for 20 to 25 minutes or until tester inserted in center comes out with just a few moist crumbs clinging to it. Let cool completely on rack. Carefully remove from pan; cut into 16 wedges. 

Pipe dots on tip of each blondie with icing to resemble reindeer’s nose. Using icing as glue, add pretzel antlers and candy eyes. Decorate between antlers with candy sprinkles.  

 

Tips:  

• Wrap these treats individually in festive holiday cellophane for easy gift-giving. 

• For speedy preparation, use a store-bought blondie mix.  

 

 

Nutrition Facts  

Per 1 reindeer  

Calories 220 

Fat 10g 

Saturated Fat 4g 

Cholesterol 20mg 

Sodium 180mg 

Carbohydrate 30g 

Fiber 1g 

Sugars 15g 

Protein 4g

title: SNICKERS Ice Cream Funnel Cake
description:
Made with pancake mix, these Snickers funnel cakes are a carnival treat that’s fun to share. 

Prep Time: 15 minutes  

Cook Time: 15 minutes  

Total Time: 30 minutes  

Makes: 12  

Ingredients:  

1 1/2 cups pancake mix 

1 tbsp granulated sugar 

1 tsp vanilla extract 

Vegetable oil, for frying  

3/4 cup 35% heavy cream 

1/4 cup icing sugar, divided  

4 (2 oz each) Snickers Ice Cream Bars 

3 tbsp caramel sauce 


Instructions:  
Whisk together dry pancake mix with 3/4 to 1 cup water, granulated sugar and vanilla until smooth. (Batter should be thick but still slightly runny.) Transfer to resealable bag with corner snipped or plastic squeeze bottle. 

Pour enough vegetable oil into medium saucepan to come 1 inch up side; heat over medium heat until instant-read thermometer reads 375°F.  

Working in batches, carefully and quickly pipe about 2 tbsp batter into saucepan, in swirling, loopy pattern to form 3-inch round. Fry for 30 seconds to 1 minute per side or until golden brown all over. Transfer to paper towel–lined tray.  

Meanwhile, using electric mixer, beat cream and 2 tbsp icing sugar until stiff peaks form. Cut each Snickers Ice Cream Bar into 3 squares.   

Dust funnel cakes with remaining icing sugar. Top each with piece of Snickers Ice Cream Bar and dollop of whipped cream. Garnish with drizzle of caramel.

Tips:  

• Alternatively, drizzle with fudge sauce instead of caramel sauce.  

• Garnish with 1/2 cup of chopped peanuts.  

 

Nutrition Facts 

Per 1 topped funnel cake 

Calories 250 

Fat 15g 

Saturated Fat 6g 

Cholesterol 25mg 

Sodium 220mg 

Carbohydrate 27g 

Fiber 1g 

Sugars 15g 

Protein 3g

title: M&M’S Vanilla Ice Cream Sandwich Tower with Toasted Marshmallow
description:
Perfect for celebrations big and small, this dessert tower is easy and fast to assemble and will wow any crowd!

Prep Time: 15 minutes
Cook Time: 5 minutes
Total Time: 20 minutes 
Serves: 16

Ingredients

1/4 cup Milk Chocolate M&M’S Minis
10 M&M’S Vanilla Ice Cream Cookie Sandwiches 
3/4 cup marshmallow spread
1 sparkler (optional)

Blowtorch

Instructions

1. Transfer Milk Chocolate M&M’S Minis to shallow bowl. Roll edges of M&M’S Vanilla Ice Cream Cookie Sandwiches in M&M’S Minis. Freeze until ready to use.
2. Transfer marshmallow spread to piping bag fitted with large plain tip.
3. Working quickly, arrange 4 ice cream sandwiches side by side on a long platter. Pipe a layer of marshmallow spread. Using blowtorch, toast marshmallow spread.
4. Create a second layer on top using 3 ice cream sandwiches, followed by a layer of marshmallow spread; toast with blowtorch.
5. Create a third layer on top using 2 ice cream sandwiches, followed by a layer of marshmallow spread; toast with blowtorch.
6. Arrange remaining ice cream sandwich on top. Pipe remaining marshmallow spread on top and toast with blowtorch. 
7. Garnish with sparkler if desired; serve immediately.


Tip: Work quickly and keep the flame moving to avoid burning. 





Nutrition Facts 
Per 1 serving (1/16 of recipe)
Calories 190
Fat 7g
Saturated Fat 3.5g
Cholesterol 10mg
Sodium 100mg
Carbohydrate 29g
Fiber 0g
Sugars 20g
Protein 2g

title: TWIX CHEETOS FLAMIN' HOT Pumpkin Pies
description:
Add these sweet and spicy mini pies to any menu to wow the crowd.  

Prep Time: 20 minutes 
Cook Time: 30 minutes  
Total Time: 50 minutes (+ 1 hour standing time) 
Makes: 12  

Ingredients: 
1 rolled refrigerator pie crust  
1/3 cup ground CHEETOS® Crunchy FLAMIN’ HOT® Cheese Flavored Snacks, divided 
1 egg yolk 
1/2 cup pumpkin purée 
2 tbsp packed brown sugar 
2 tbsp evaporated milk 
1/2 tsp pumpkin pie spice 
1/2 tsp vanilla extract 
1/8 tsp salt 
8 Twix® Fun Size® Bars, divided 
1/4 cup heavy or whipping (35%) cream, whipped  
2 tbsp caramel sauce 

Instructions:  
1. Preheat oven to 350°F.  
2. Place pie crust on lightly floured work surface and sprinkle 2 tbsp ground CHEETOS® Crunchy FLAMIN’ HOT® Cheese Flavored Snacks evenly over crust. Using rolling pin, gently press into crust. Flip crust over and sprinkle 2 tbsp ground CHEETOS over crust. Using rolling pin, gently press into crust. 
3. Using 3-inch round cookie cutter, cut out 12 rounds, rerolling scraps as needed. Reserve any remaining scraps for another use.  
4. Fit pastry rounds into 12 mini muffin cups. Chill in refrigerator for 10 minutes to firm up pastry. Using fork, prick bottoms of pastry cups. Line pastry shells with mini muffin liners and fill with pie weights. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly golden.   
5. Remove weights and liners. Bake for 4 to 6 minutes or until pastry is golden brown and crisp. Let cool completely.  
6. In medium bowl, whisk together egg yolk, pumpkin purée, brown sugar, evaporated milk, pumpkin pie spice, vanilla and salt until blended.  
7. Chop 2 Twix® Fun Size® Bars and divide among pie shells. Pour in pumpkin purée mixture.  
8. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until filling is just set. Let cool completely. 
9. Cut remaining Twix in half diagonally. Just before serving, garnish each mini pie with small dollop of whipped cream, Twix half, remaining ground CHEETOS and drizzle of caramel sauce.  

Tip:  
•  Alternatively, use your favorite whipped topping if preferred.  

 
Nutrition Facts  
Per 1 mini pie 
Calories 160 
Fat 8g 
Saturated Fat 4g 
Cholesterol 25mg 
Sodium 135mg 
Carbohydrate 20g 
Fiber 0g 
Sugars 10g 
Protein 2g

title: TWIX Ghosts Recipe
description:
These quick and easy Twix Ghosts make a fun no-bake Halloween treat that everyone will love.  
 
Prep Time: 20 minutes 
Cook Time: 0 minutes  
Total Time: 20 minutes (+ 20 minutes standing time) 
Makes: 12 servings 
 
Ingredients: 
12 Twix Fun Size bars 
3 oz white chocolate chips, melted 
12 mini dark chocolate chips 
1 small tube brown or black icing 
 
Instructions:  
1. Spoon 2 tsp of melted white chocolate onto each Twix Fun Size bar, spreading to cover three-quarters of each bar. Place on parchment paper–lined baking sheet. 
2. With undipped portion of Twix at the bottom, place 1 chocolate chip about one-third of the way down from the top of the bar on the icing to resemble the ghost’s mouth.  
3. Let stand for about 5 minutes or until white chocolate is slightly set. Pipe 2 small dots of brown icing above each ghost’s mouth to resemble the eyes. Refrigerate for 10 to 15 minutes or until white chocolate is completely set.  

Tips:  
• Substitute white candy melts for white chocolate chips if preferred.  
• Alternatively, use black icing or melted dark chocolate instead of chocolate chips to make the ghost’s mouth, letting the white chocolate set before piping.

1. Spoon 2 tsp of melted white chocolate onto each Twix Fun Size bar, spreading to cover three-quarters of each bar. Place on parchment paper–lined baking sheet. 
2. With undipped portion of Twix at the bottom, place 1 chocolate chip about one-third of the way down from the top of the bar on the icing to resemble the ghost’s mouth.  
3. Let stand for about 5 minutes or until white chocolate is slightly set. Pipe 2 small dots of brown icing above each ghost’s mouth to resemble the eyes. Refrigerate for 10 to 15 minutes or until white chocolate is completely set.

title: From Farm to Shelf: See How Triscuit is Made Simply
description:
The journey of triscuit is simple. It begins in the heartland of America where local farmers and bakers create the delicious triscuit cracker, making it one great snack you can feel good about, no matter how you top it.
 
The delicious whole grain wheat is grown and harvested by passionate, generational family farmers. Some of these farmers have adopted regenerative agriculture practices that help protect the soil and optimize fertilizer use, such as using cover crops, implementing crop rotation, and practicing reduced tilling.
 
Triscuit also works with Michigan State University  https://www.canr.msu.edu/outreach/ Field to Market https://fieldtomarket.org/ and CO-OP Elevator https://www.coopelev.com/ to collect data from these farmers and advise them on ways to increase wheat yields, improve soil health, and reduce carbon emissions.
 
Triscuit, as part of Mondelēz International, is working towards improving the environmental footprint of the wheat we source. Find more of our efforts both in the U.S. and worldwide in the 2022 Mondelēz International Snacking Made Right Report here: https://www.mondelezinternational.com/Snacking-Made-Right/Reporting-and-Disclosure/

title: White Castle Jalapeño Slider Stuffing with Fat Joe 🔥🌶️🍔
description:
Fat Joe adds his “Sazón de Latino” flavor 🌶️ to his White Castle Jalapeño Slider Stuffing! Spice up the holidays! Link in bio

INGREDIENTS:
12 White Castle® Jalapeño Cheese Sliders
10 tablespoons Butter
1 cup diced celery
1 finely-diced Jalapeño Pepper
1 teaspoon sazón
1 teaspoon salt
1 & 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
1 & 1/2 teaspoons cumin
1/4 cup chopped cilantro
3/4 cup turkey or chicken broth
2 eggs
1 cup shredded pepper jack cheese

 
Instructions:
 
Melt your butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add celery and jalapeño pepper and cook until soft.
Heat your Sliders according to package instructions. Cut into quarters.
In a large mixing bowl or pan, mix quartered Sliders with the sazón, salt, pepper, and cumin. Mix in the cilantro and the vegetables from the skillet. If cooking the stuffing in the turkey, add the pepper jack cheese here as well.
In a small bowl, mix broth and eggs. Pour over your stuffing mixture and stir until distributed evenly.
Place stuffing mixture in a 9"x13" baking dish and top with your pepper jack cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes covered. 
After 30 minutes, uncover and continue cooking for about 15-20 minutes, until browned on top.

title: How to Make: Daily Harvest Oat Bowls
description:
Oatmeal is only boring if you want it to be. With real, whole fruit and nourishing superfoods, gluten-free rolled oats transform into a one-step breakfast that brings long-lasting energy with minimal effort. 

Here we show you how to prepare the Apple + Cinnamon Oat Bowl. 

OVERVIEW
If an apple a day keeps the doctor away, imagine what our Apple + Cinnamon Oat Bowl can do. It packs 100% of your daily Vitamin C to keep your immune system sharp, plus cinnamon and cloves for fresh-baked flavor and cauliflower to keep you feeling light and energized.

Hot: 
STEP 1
Fill cup ¾ of the way with your preferred milk. Stir.

STEP 2
Empty into a pot or microwave-safe bowl.

STEP 3
For stovetop, cook over medium-high heat for 3-6 minutes. For microwave, heat 3-6 minutes, stirring halfway in between. Enjoy. 

Cold: 
STEP 1
Fill cup with your preferred milk ¾ of the way to the top. Stir.

STEP 2
Put lid back on and soak in the fridge overnight (6+ hours).

STEP 3
Stir and enjoy.

description:

Ingredients
3 cups cooked turkey or chicken 
1 cup prepared stuffing 
1 cup prepared mashed potatoes 
1 cup corn, or other vegetable 
1 cup turkey gravy 
1 cup shredded Cheddar cheese 
FRENCH'S® Crispy Fried Onions, plus additional for garnish 
4 small green or red bell peppers, halved lengthwise and seeded

2 Tbsp. water

Tips
Turkey mixture can be layered over mashed potatoes and baked or heated and served in flour tortillas.

title: French’s Cheeseburger Dip | We Promise Great Taste
description:

-RECIPE- http://bit.ly/1nD6vc0

Ingredients:
1/2 lb. ground beef, (can use up to 1 lb. of ground beef.) 
1 (8 oz. pkg.) cream cheese, softened 
1/2 cup shredded American cheese (or substitute 1/2 cup of cheddar cheese)
1/4 cup FRENCH'S® Tomato Ketchup 
1/4 cup mayonnaise 
2 Tbsp. FRENCH'S® Classic Yellow Mustard 
2 Tbsp. FRENCH'S® Classic Worcestershire Sauce 
2 Tbsp. dill pickle relish 

Directions:
BROWN meat in skillet; drain and set aside.
COMBINE all other ingredients in deep pie dish. Fold in meat.
HEAT in 350°F oven for 15 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Garnish with bacon crumbles and French's Crispy Fried Onions , if desired. Serve with pita chips.

title: Ranch Tomato Soup 🍅🥣
description:
A warm bowl of Ranch Tomato Soup on a chilly day like this would heal me rn 🍅🍜
 
Recipe:
-Cut up 6 lbs of tomatoes and place them in 2 foil pans.
-Add 2 cut up large onions 4 garlic cloves.
-Cover with olive oil, a pack of ranch seasoning, and mix it up.
-Bake at 350F for 1 hour or until everything is roasted and soft.
-Transfer it all to a large soup pot, add a shot of worcestershire sauce and blend it to a liquid.
-Salt and pepper to taste, and simmer.
-Serve with grilled cheese.

title: Yummy Sweet Cinnamon Pistachio Cookies!
description:
If the holidays had a signature cookie, this would be it. 🍪 Pumpkin, dark chocolate, and Wonderful Pistachios Sweet Cinnamon No Shells come together for one ridiculously good gluten-free treat! Full recipe below 👇​
​
Ingredients:​
- 1 ½ cups gluten free 1 to 1 flour​
- ⅔ cups coconut sugar​
- 1 tsp baking soda​
- 1 tsp cinnamon​
- Pinch of nutmeg​
- ½ cup coconut oil melted​
- ½ cup pumpkin puree​
- 1 tsp vanilla extract​
- 1 cup dark chocolate chips​
- ½ cup chopped pistachios, plus more for topping

Directions: ​
Preheat oven to 350 degrees and line a baking pan with parchment paper ​
Add flour, sugar, baking soda, cinnamon, and nutmeg to a large bowl or stand mixer. Stir to combine. ​
Add in all remaining ingredients except chocolate chips and chopped pistachios. Stir until a cookie dough consistency is reached. ​
Fold in dark chocolate chips and chopped pistachios. ​
Use cookie scoop or ice cream scoop to drop balls of dough onto lined baking pan. ​
Slightly flatten each cookie with your fingers or spatula. ​
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until middle of cookies are set. ​
Remove from oven. Allow cookies to set on pan for 10 minutes before moving to a wire rack to finish cooling.​

title: Have you had inside-out doner kebabs yet?! 🤯
description:
Viral Doner kebabs except the meat IS the wrap
1 lb ground beef
3 large eggs
1 tsp baking powder
1 Tbsp onion powder
1 Tbsp garlic powder
2 tsp ground cumin
2 tsp ground coriander
2 tsp smoked paprika
1½ tsp salt
1 tsp dried oregano
½ tsp ground black pepper
2 Tbsp Primal Kitchen Tzatziki Style Dressing
1-2 Tbsp Primal Kitchen Avocado Oil

Wrap:
Iceberg lettuce
Cherry tomatoes
Cucumber
Red Onion
Feta
Primal Kitchen Tzatziki Style Dressing


1. Preheat the oven to 375℉.
2. Add the meat, eggs, baking powder, and all the spices to a food processor. Pulse until completely incorporated. Divide into six equal portions and roll into balls.
3. Place a sheet of parchment paper on a flat surface and drizzle lightly with avocado oil. Place two meat balls on the oiled paper about 6 inches apart and flatten into circles.
4. Lightly oil the tops and place a second sheet of parchment paper on top. Roll or press the meat until both discs are approximately ¼ inch thick. Remove the top sheet of paper and roll the bottom sheet with the meat still inside. Repeat for the remaining four meat balls.
5. Place all three parchment rolls on a lined baking sheet in place in the oven. Bake for 25 minutes.
6. Remove from the oven and let sit for a few minutes to cool slightly. Carefully unwrap the meat.
7. Load up each with lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, and onion. Top with feta, then drizzle with tzatziki dressing. Fold up the sides of the meat like flatbread or a tortilla. Serve with more tzatziki dressing for dipping. Enjoy!

title: Red Velvet Banana Pudding by Magnolia Bakery
description:
INGREDIENTS: 
One 14 ounce can, sweetened condensed milk
1 ½ cups ice cold water
One 3.4-ounce package instant vanilla pudding mix (preferably Jell-O brand)
8 ounces of cream cheese, softened and cut into 8 pieces
3 cups heavy cream
One 9 x 13 inch layer of red velvet cake 
4 – 5 ripe bananas
1 cup of mini chocolate chips

TECHNIQUE:
In a small bowl, on the medium speed of an electric mixer, mix the sweetened condensed milk and water together until well combined, about 1 minute.  

Add the pudding mix and mix until there are no lumps and the mixture is smooth, about 2 minutes. Cover and refrigerate for 3-4 hours or overnight. 

Place the pudding mixture into the mixer bowl with the whisk attachment, add the cream cheese to the pudding mix. Mix until thoroughly combined and smooth. Place in the refrigerator while you prepare the whipped cream. 

In a clean mixer bowl with the whisk attachment whip the heavy cream on medium speed for about one minute until the cream starts to thicken, then increase the speed to medium high and whip the cream until stiff peaks form. Be careful not to over whip. Carefully add the pudding mixture into the whipped cream and mix on low speed until well blended and no streaks of pudding remain. 

Cut the red velvet cake into 4 inch squares. Cut each square into ½” layers. Set aside. 

To assemble the pudding select either a trifle bowl or a wide glass bowl with a 4-5-quart capacity. Spread a layer of pudding on the bottom and layer with enough slices of the red velvet cake to cover the layer, add sliced banana to cover the cake and sprinkle with 1/3 cup of mini chips.  Continue layering with 1/3 of the pudding mixture, another layer of cake, sliced bananas and mini chips. Repeat one more time ending with pudding. Sprinkle the top with crumbled red velvet cake and a tablespoon of mini chips. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and allow to chill in the refrigerator for 4 hours or overnight before serving.

title: Factor 75 Meals | Founder Nick Wernimont
description:
Factor 75 is a meal delivery service with a focus on providing fresh, high quality meals to people on the go. We offer meal options that are paleo, vegetarian, gluten-free, and more. 

Visit https://www.factor75.com/ to schedule your first meal delivery!

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

"I was fighting ... MMA fighter. Also had a full time job. Thought I was eating healthy and I thought I knew what nutrition was, but a few years into it my body was basically breaking down and it was very tired and run down. Fortunately, one of my trainers introduced me to a personal chef who worked with a lot of athletes. She started making meals and delivering them to me. The difference that they made was incredible and almost immediate. The biggest factor that impacted how well I performed and really my quality of life was food.

I figured how many people out there are like me that want to look, feel, and perform at their best and don't have the time or the skills to eat optimally. I can't be the only person who would love to feel this way, live this way, and not have to spend two to three hours every day just doing meal prep. It's as simple as offering people that want to perform at a higher level no matter what they're doing an option that allows them still to live their life, and do all the things they need to deal with in their job and their family but still be able to eat healthy and perform well through doing so.

Last time I actually saw my buddy was at a family ski trip in Colorado and he drove me to the airport. We had a great conversation, he had some really good insight, and he was really helpful in listening and was very giving of his time and his focus. After he passed, it changed my perspective way more than I ever would have anticipated as far as what is really important, what really matters. At the end of the day, I want to start a business that he would be proud of and I want him to be proud of me and I think that Factor 75 has been a vehicle for me to do a lot of things in that one, I can help people live a better, fuller life. Two, I can do something that I'm very passionate about and love doing. Three, it can allow me to have the ability to spend more time and more quality time with my family.

The time that you save and the impact that nutrition has can allow you to spend more time and a better quality time with your family doing the things that matter most with the people that matter most and then really enjoying a fuller life because of our service."

title: Bai Spicy Pineapple Margarita
description:
Create this delicious Spicy Pineapple Margarita at your next fiesta. We promise it will be a hit.

INGREDIENTS:
1 can of Bai Bubbles Peru Pineapple
2 Fresh limes – Juiced
2 Fresh chiles – Sliced
3 oz. Tequila
3 oz. Triple sec
1/2 Fresh lime
1 tbsp. Coarse sea salt for rimming the glass
1 tbsp. Tajin seasoning for rimming the glass
Fresh pineapple for garnish

DIRECTIONS:
Put juice from two fresh limes, half of the sliced chilis, tequila and triple sec in a shaker with ice and shake well. Rim glasses with a wedge of lime and dip into tajin/salt mixture. Fill glasses with ice and add remaining chilis. Pour mixture into two glasses and top with Bai Bubbles.

Must be 21+. Please drink responsibly.

For more recipes, head to our blog: https://www.drinkbai.com/blog

½ cup Bai Brasilia Blueberry
1 cup Frozen mixed berries
½ cup Almond milk
2 tbsp Peanut butter
1-2 scoops Vanilla protein powder
¼ cup Oats
Hemp seeds
Chia seeds
Fresh berries

DIRECTIONS:

Blend all the ingredients except for seeds and fresh berries. Add more Brasilia Blueberry if needed. Pour into a glass and garnish with seeds of your choice and fresh berries.

title: Trolli Dirt Cake
description:
Step up your snack game with this sweet and #SourSnackHack. 

Recipe:
20 oz. package of Oreos
2 - 3.5 oz. packages of instant vanilla pudding
3 1/2 cups milk
1/2 stick of butter, room temperature
8 oz. cream cheese
1 cup powdered sugar
8 oz. container of Cool Whip
2 Packages Trolli Sour Brite Crawlers
Optional: food coloring


1. In a medium bowl, mix both of the packages of vanilla pudding with the milk. 
2. In a second small/medium bowl, blend the butter, cream cheese and powdered sugar together.
3. Crush up the Oreos in a plastic bag.
4. Stir the thickened pudding and add the cream cheese mixture, Cool Whip and food coloring.
5. In a large clear bowl so you can see the layers, pour a layer of pudding. Cover it with a layer of Oreos and Crawlers. Repeat until you're out of pudding, Oreos and Crawlers. 
6. Eat!
